fine_lines.title: this vs these
fine_lines.explanation_ar: this للمفرد (شخص واحد)، وthese للجمع (أكثر من شخص). This is my mum. / These are my parents.
fine_lines.explanation_en: This is for one person; these is for two or more. This is ... / These are ...

fine_lines.title: niece vs nephew
fine_lines.explanation_ar: niece = بنت الأخ أو الأخت، وnephew = ابن الأخ أو الأخت.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Niece = your brother's or sister's daughter. Nephew = their son.

examples.sentence: This is my niece, my sister's daughter.
This is my nephew, my brother's son.

fine_lines.title: aunt vs uncle
fine_lines.explanation_ar: aunt = العمة أو الخالة (أنثى)، وuncle = العم أو الخال (ذكر).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Aunt is a woman (your parent's sister). Uncle is a man (your parent's brother).

fine_lines.title: older vs younger
fine_lines.explanation_ar: older = أكبر سنًا، وyounger = أصغر سنًا. نضعهما قبل brother/sister.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Older = born before you. Younger = born after you.

expressions.example: Who's in your family? This is my mum and this is my dad.

expressions.meaning_en: asking what someone is looking at
expressions.example: What are you looking at? This is my family tree.

expressions.meaning_en: asking about two or more people
expressions.example: Who are they? These are my two nieces.
Who is that? That's my husband.

expressions.phrase: Do you have any brothers or sisters?
expressions.example: Do you have any brothers or sisters? Yes, I have one younger sister.
Do you have any sons? No, I don't.

expressions.meaning_en: short negative answer to Do you have ...?
expressions.example: Do you have any nieces or nephews? No, I don't.

expressions.meaning_en: saying you have no brothers or sisters
expressions.example: Do you have any brothers or sisters? No, I'm an only child.

expressions.phrase: We're talking about our family trees.
expressions.meaning_en: saying what you are doing now
expressions.example: What are you doing? We're talking about our family trees.

expressions.phrase: Do you remember who this is?
expressions.meaning_en: asking someone to recall a person
expressions.example: Do you remember who this is? This is Sian's daughter.

grammar.title: This is ... / These are ...
grammar.explanation_ar: نقدّم شخصًا واحدًا بـ This is، وأكثر من شخص بـ These are. ولشخص بعيد نقول That's.
grammar.explanation_en: Introduce one person with This is, two or more with These are. For someone further away: That's.
examples: These are my parents: my mum and dad.

grammar.title: Possessive 's
grammar.explanation_ar: لنقول إن شخصًا ينتمي إلى شخص آخر نضيف 's إلى الاسم: Sian's daughter = ابنة شيان.
grammar.explanation_en: Add 's to a name to show family or ownership: Sian's daughter.

grammar.title: Do you have any ...? Yes, I have ... / No, I don't.
grammar.explanation_ar: نسأل عن أفراد العائلة بـ Do you have any + جمع؟ والجواب: Yes, I have ... أو No, I don't.
grammar.explanation_en: Ask Do you have any + plural noun? Answer: Yes, I have ... / No, I don't.
examples: Do you have any sons? No, I don't.
Do you have any brothers or sisters? Yes, I have one older brother and two sisters.
Do you have any nieces or nephews? No, I don't.
